key_idea: Add the long sticks in a row, then the stick standing at the end.
steps: Across the top lie 3 long sticks, end to end. The bottom is the same.
So the row is 5 + 5 + 5 = 15 cm long.
At the right end, one more stick stands up next to the row. It is 1 cm wide.

choice_feedback.A: Do not forget the standing stick at the right end. It adds 1 cm.
choice_feedback.B: The standing sticks inside the pattern do not add length. Only the one at the right end does.
choice_feedback.C: There are only 3 long sticks in each row, not 4.
choice_feedback.E: 3 sticks of 5 cm are already 15 cm, so the pattern is longer than 14 cm.
